title: AgentRM: Enhancing Agent Generalization with Reward Modeling
authors_zh: Yu Xia, Jingru Fan, Weize Chen, Siyu Yan, Xin Cong, Zhong Zhang, Yaxi Lu, Yankai Lin, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
paper_type_zh: 智能体过程奖励与测试时搜索评测论文
best_for_zh: 需要审计奖励信号迁移性和智能体搜索可靠性的研究者。
one_line: An 8B reward model with released code and data for testing whether reward-guided search generalizes across unseen agent tasks.
用搜索状态价值训练通用过程奖励，以测试时搜索提升智能体跨任务表现。
why: It provides an auditable public surface for measuring or mitigating reward and judge reliability failures.
inclusion_reason: Track 13 addition: it exposes a concrete reward, judge, or evaluation-reliability surface with a public official artifact.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Agents often perform well on the environments used for policy training yet fail when an unseen task requires a different action policy. Directly diversifying policy fine-tuning can overfit those environments, leaving test-time selection unreliable.

AgentRM addresses that failure by learning a general process reward model from agent search trajectories and using it to rank or expand actions at inference time. It is an audit-relevant reward-reliability study: the output is a learned selection signal for agent behavior, not a benchmark-contamination detector. - Concrete problem: what research or engineering gap the paper is trying to close. - Why it matters for this atlas: which reasoning-data, verifier, reward, environment, benchmark, or audit question it clarifies. - Data object / evaluation surface: what one sample, episode, task, trace, or benchmark instance contains. - L4 collection note: what official source and local card evidence make it ready to include without another topic-approval round.

已有智能体在训练过的环境中表现良好，却常在需要新最优行为的未见任务上失效；直接扩充策略微调会使策略记住环境动作模式，测试时仍缺少可靠选择信号。

AgentRM 从搜索轨迹学习可泛化的过程奖励，并在推理时排序或扩展动作。它审计奖励信号能否跨任务指导智能体，而不是检测训练集污染。

AgentRM 是一个 8B 过程奖励模型：它把搜索树状态价值转为推理时的选择信号。Best-of-N 或 beam search 依据它挑选路径，策略仍可用于未见任务。官方公开代码和数据以复现实验；核心产物是奖励引导的智能体评测协议，而非污染检测数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Initialize exploration. The authors SFT LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct on expert trajectories from WebShop, Alfworld, and SciWorld.
  1. Estimate state values. An MCTS-inspired loop selects with UCB, samples actions, rolls them to environment outcomes, and back-propagates values. States with too few visits are filtered.
  1. Train reward models. Explicit RM regresses retained values with MSE; implicit RM learns from 16 complete trajectories per instruction and progress rewards. LLM-as-a-judge is a training-free baseline.
  1. Search at inference. Best-of-N scores complete trajectories; beam search retains high-scoring states. Reproduction requires fixed environments, checkpoints, search widths, rollout budget, and reward definition.

1. 初始化探索。 作者用 WebShop、Alfworld 和 SciWorld 的专家轨迹微调 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct。
  1. 估计状态价值。 类 MCTS 循环按 UCB 选节点、采样动作、rollout 到环境结果并回传价值；访问过少的状态被过滤。
  1. 训练奖励模型。 显式 RM 用 MSE 拟合保留价值；隐式 RM 对每条指令采样 16 条完整轨迹并学习进度奖励；LLM-as-a-judge 是不训练的对照。
  1. 推理搜索。 Best-of-N 对完整轨迹打分，beam search 保留高分状态。复现须固定环境、checkpoint、搜索宽度、rollout 预算和奖励定义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: With LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct fixed as policy across nine tasks, Table 1 reports 61.5 overall for explicit-RM Best-of-5 versus 52.7 for greedy search, an 8.8-point gain; beam search reaches 63.3. The comparison supports reward-guided search in this 8B/environment configuration, not universal transfer to other reward models or environments.
在九个任务中固定 LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct 为策略后，表 1 的显式 RM Best-of-5 总分为 61.5，greedy search 为 52.7，提升 8.8 点；beam search 为 63.3。该比较支持这一 8B 模型和环境配置下的奖励引导搜索，不能证明任意奖励模型或环境都会迁移。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior agent work commonly specializes a policy or process reward model to a task. AgentRM changes the supervised object: one reward model is trained from search-derived state values on three environments, then guides a policy on held-out tasks. MCTS, value regression, Best-of-N, and beam search are not individually new; the contribution is the general-reward transfer contract.
既有智能体工作常把策略或过程奖励模型专门训练到单一任务。AgentRM 改变了监督对象：从三个环境的搜索状态价值训练一个奖励模型，再让它指导策略处理未见任务。MCTS、价值回归、Best-of-N 和 beam search 本身并不新；贡献在于通用奖励的迁移契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors train on only three held-in interactive environments because adding environments requires manual implementation, so broader coverage is untested. They do not combine the policy with agent prompt engineering or policy RL. Reuse should measure reward calibration and search gains in the target environment rather than treat the reported average as a general guarantee.
作者仅在三个训练环境上构建奖励，因为新增交互环境需要人工实现，故更广任务覆盖尚未验证。论文也未将策略与 agent prompt engineering 或策略 RL 结合。复用时应在目标环境单独测量奖励校准与搜索增益，不能把平均分当作通用保证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use AgentRM when an agent environment supplies a terminal reward or progress signal and a team needs to compare reward-guided search with a fixed policy. Input expert traces or exploratory episodes, train a state scorer, and report held-out task reward against greedy and equal-budget search; the output is an auditable selection policy. Do not use the learned score as ground truth where the environment reward is incomplete or misaligned.
当环境提供终局奖励或进度信号，且团队需要在固定策略下检验奖励引导搜索时可用。输入专家轨迹或探索 episode，训练状态打分器，并在留出任务上与 greedy 和等预算搜索比较奖励；输出是可审计的选择策略。若环境奖励不完整或与真实成功不一致，不应把该分数当作真值。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: a cross-task process reward model, not another task-specific agent.
  2. Mechanism: UCB search estimates state values; MSE trains explicit RM; search consumes scores at test time.
  3. Artifact: code and data are released, but the useful object is the environment-plus-reward construction.
  4. Evidence: explicit RM Best-of-5 is 61.5 versus greedy 52.7 over nine tasks.
  5. Reuse decision: first audit whether terminal/progress reward really represents success in the target environment.

1. 定位：跨任务过程奖励模型，不是新的任务专用智能体。
  2. 方法：UCB 搜索估计状态价值，显式 RM 用 MSE 训练，推理阶段由搜索消费分数。
  3. Artifact：公开代码和数据，但可复用对象是“环境加奖励”的构造。
  4. 证据：九任务中显式 RM Best-of-5 为 61.5，greedy 为 52.7。
  5. 复用决定：先审计目标环境的终局或进度奖励是否真正代表成功。
